thread:
rachel: Noticing a spike in TLS handshake failures between proxy->edge in eu-west after the tls-hardening PR merged. Failures look like 'session ticket unwrap failed' and 'SNI mismatch' in envoy logs.
dmitri: Error rates?
rachel: ~0.6% overall but spikes to 2% during deploy windows. Root log sample: "tls: session_ticket_wrap_error: KMS:AccessDenied" from proxy-0.
ellie: We rolled an RBAC tighten yesterday that replaced a broad role with a set of allow-lists. Did that touch rotator/proxy permissions?
rotator: The rotator service issues session ticket keys and rotates them wrapped via KMS. I can confirm some proxy instances are failing to wrap new ticket keys: KMS reports kms:Encrypt denied for principal proxy-eu-role on alias "session-ticket-wrap-eu".
dmitri: So unwraps fail on the receiving side because proxies can't wrap tickets for clients? timeline?
rotator: Flow: rotator generates key material, encrypts (Encrypt) with regional KMS alias and distributes to proxies. If proxies can't Encrypt, they can't produce the ticket blob expected by other regions -> handshake rejects due to ticket format / key id mismatch.
sre-oncall: Impact: mostly increased latency + retries; some internal healthchecks failing and triggering paging at 2% on peak. No external user 5xx yet.
sec-bot: Triage: operational vulnerability: RBAC change removed kms:Encrypt on proxy role. Also audit gap: our audit-forwarder suppressed KMS.Encrypt events for write-type ops when origin != central. Need both fix and better logging.
ellie: Immediate mitigation: 1) Grant kms:Encrypt back to proxy-eu-role scoped to the alias 2) Temporarily disable session tickets across regions to avoid cross-region ticket exchange 3) Roll a canary rotator that uses inline ticket keys to test behavior. Which one first?
dmitri: Quickest is to grant least-priv kms:Encrypt for proxy-eu-role with Resource=alias/session-ticket-wrap-eu and Condition limiting sourceIp or requestor:service to proxy-eu*; then restart a small set of proxies.
rotator: We can also change rotator to produce tickets in a compat mode: include a fallback 'legacy_ticket_key_id' and allow proxies to accept wrapped tickets without additional KMS ops for 30m. That requires a small coord PR.
sre-oncall: Ops plan: - patch RBAC to re-add kms:Encrypt (ETA 15m) - restart canary proxies (ETA +10m) - if canary success reduce to 0.1% within 10m, roll out - if not, disable session tickets cluster-by-cluster (config snippet below).
dmitri: Config snippet to disable session tickets on envoy cluster: ```tls_context: { session_ticket_keys: [] }``` This forces full handshake and avoids wrap errors.
ellie: Audit fix: enable forwarding for KMS Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign events to sec-audit and tag with key_alias and principal. Also add a metric for kms:Encrypt_denied to alert faster.
sre-oncall: Also add a synthetic test: nightly job that simulates RBAC deny on proxy role and validates fallback path.
rotator: Hotfix applied: proxy-eu-role now has kms:Encrypt on alias session-ticket-wrap-eu. KMS logs show Encrypt success at 5256789125 for proxy-1.
sre-oncall: Canary report at 5256789220: handshake_fail_rate dropped from 0.6% -> 0.05% on canary set. Rolling to remaining proxies.
ellie: Followups: - audit the recent RBAC diffs for any other missing KMS actions - add CI lint check to prevent removing kms:Encrypt from proxy roles - doc runbook entry for session-ticket rotation.
dmitri: Long-term: move session ticket wrapping to a control-plane service with single HSM-backed signer + short-lived delegation tokens so proxies don't need kms:Encrypt at all. Also ensure aliases replicate and have consistent ACLs across regions.
sre-oncall: Incident filed INC-2026-03-5256789012 (tag: session-ticket-wrap-rbac). Escalation policy: P1 if error rate >1% after fixes.
sec-bot: Please attach KMS audit snippets and RBAC change ID to the incident.
rachel: Thanks team. I'll update the incident doc with timeline and link the PRs once open. :thumbsup:
